recap.summary: Three months, open to anyone, any tool. 31 recorded workshop sessions ran through June. 31 projects came in from 15 people across the artist, builder and creator tracks. Two people per track reached the Finals, and the six went head to head live on WaveWarZ in the last week of August: the artist battle on 24 August, the creator battle on 27 August, and the builder battle over 24 hours from noon on 29 August. Every finalist was paid. That closes season 1; season 2 comes next.

_prize_note: PRIZE, corrected 2026-09-13 by Zaal, asked directly because the record claimed the whole pool was paid. His words: "no paid no one had any decent volume". So the 500 USDC pool DISBURSED 450: 100 to each of the three track champions (300) and 50 to each of the three runners-up (150). The third part, 50 USDC for the highest trading volume across the season, was NOT PAID - no finalist had meaningful volume. The pool was still funded at 500 by the ZAO festivals team, so "a 500 USDC pool" is correct and "500 USDC paid" is not. Do not name a volume-award winner: there is none, and the trading figures were never captured (see finals.json _signals_note). What becomes of the unpaid 50 is not decided and nothing about it is recorded here on purpose - THIS FILE IS SERVED at zabalgamez.com/data/season-1-results.json, so anything written here is published.
